FFmpeg/WASM third-party notice
================================

This application distributes the following ffmpeg.wasm release artifacts for
the optional audio-import compatibility path. They are loaded only after the
browser's native Web Audio decoder reports an unsupported encoding.

Release provenance
------------------

Upstream project: https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm
Upstream release: https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/releases/tag/v12.15
Source tag: v12.15
Source commit: 71aa99d37c02a7b4c435275ca9ef50e612f6efa1
Complete release source and build scripts:
https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/tree/71aa99d37c02a7b4c435275ca9ef50e612f6efa1

The application self-hosts the unmodified @ffmpeg/core WASM bytes in gzip
form as ffmpeg-core-0.12.10.wasm.gz. The browser expands those bytes only when
the compatibility decoder is first needed. Compression changes the transport
representation, not the executable contents or license.
